messages.subject: joint model for point pattern data
parts:
Hi

I have three types of observations, which are point pattern data. 
I use log gaussian cox processes (LGCP) to analyze each category separately, and I have found that their spatial effects overlap. 
So I prefer to analyze the spatial effects of sharing. Should I use the joint model, or maybe there is a joint LGCP? .

Any suggest or help will be very appreciated. 

Best.

> For joint model, I am not sure how to organize inla.stack In INLA_MVPP ,
>
> I know the organization of y and e, but I am not sure about A and effects in inla.stack.....have more details or tips?

Try to follow the examples in the code and modify the code therein. You will need to define several stacks for the different point patterns and their effects. Then you will need to create a joint stack with all of them. But, as I said, try to go though the code first.

Best,

Virgilio
